fusions.name: Drifting Seed Pods
fusions.desc: Sets 2 floating seed pods drifting out, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Unhurried Fell
fusions.desc: Sets a waterlogged mangrove log drifting at the first enemy in its path, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Seagrass Meadow
fusions.desc: Grows a meadow of seagrass where you stand. For 12 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it, within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mending
fusions.desc: When you take damage that is not fire, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
